plan.order: AB/BA alternating fresh processes, no samples dropped
plan.timing: No warmup, matrix I/O excluded. Native compute includes actual finite/structure scans, graph, factor/export. Library factor excludes finite checks, packing and cleanup; wrapper includes them. Band library takes explicit KD7; its wrapper excludes certifying off-band zeros. Neither library timer includes source compilation or symbolic Metadata.
plan.limits: Shared host, no affinity or thermal isolation. Results compare one installed OpenBLAS 0.3.30 build, not all best libraries.
